description: This file defines the ParameterListExclusionStrategy class, which implements the ExclusionStrategy interface from Gson to determine which fields should be skipped during JSON serialization based on a set of parameter names.

classes.name: ParameterListExclusionStrategy
classes.description: Implements Gson's ExclusionStrategy to skip specified fields during JSON serialization based on parameter names.

methods.name: ParameterListExclusionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set of parameter names to skip.

methods.name: shouldSkipField
methods.description: Determines whether a given field should be skipped based on its name and the parameterNamesToSkip set.

methods.name: shouldSkipClass
methods.description: Always returns false; does not skip any class.
